verdict.rationale: Pomelo documents card program management it runs for the client: issuing nominated, unnominated, virtual and physical cards, design/production and logistics, tokenization, dashboard monitoring, and escalating disputes with the card brands. It also documents a time-to-first-card figure: a record 11 days from kickoff to the first real-world transaction on a virtual card. However, nothing in the pack explicitly says Pomelo provides BIN sponsorship or holds network membership on the founder's behalf, and the 11-day figure is a best case rather than a typical signup-to-live timeline. missing for 10: explicit BIN sponsorship / issuing-bank arrangement, documented Visa/Mastercard network membership handled by the platform, typical (not record) signup-to-first-live-card timeline, independent corroboration

support.subject: As a founder, I can launch a card program without becoming a bank — BIN sponsorship, network membership, and program management are the platform's problem, and the time from signup to first live card is documented
